<!--
Thank you for contributing. Keep this PR focused and remove sections that do not apply.
感谢你的贡献。请保持 PR 聚焦，可删除不适用的小节。
-->

## Summary / 变更摘要

<!-- What changed and why? / 修改了什么，为什么？ -->

## Related Issue / 关联 Issue

<!-- Use "Closes #123" when applicable. / 适用时使用 "Closes #123"。 -->

## Scope / 范围

<!-- State both what is included and what intentionally remains unchanged. / 同时说明包含内容与明确不改的内容。 -->

## Change Type / 变更类型

- [ ] Bug fix / 错误修复
- [ ] Feature / 功能
- [ ] Documentation / 文档
- [ ] Test or maintenance / 测试或维护
- [ ] Security-sensitive change / 安全敏感变更
- [ ] UI change / 界面变更
- [ ] Packaging or release change / 打包或发布变更

## Validation / 验证

<!-- List exact commands and results. Do not write only "tested". / 列出准确命令与结果，不要只写“已测试”。 -->

```text
npm run lint
npm test
```

## UI Evidence / 界面证据

<!-- For UI changes, include desktop/mobile screenshots and note overflow or console checks. / UI 改动请提供桌面端和移动端截图，并说明溢出与控制台检查。 -->

## Risk and Rollback / 风险与回退

<!-- Identify behavior at risk and the smallest rollback unit. / 说明风险行为和最小回退单元。 -->

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.zh-CN.md`. / 我已阅读贡献指南。
- [ ] This PR is focused and contains no unrelated refactor. / 本 PR 保持聚焦，不含无关重构。
- [ ] Tests cover the changed behavior, or I explained why no test is needed. / 测试覆盖了变更，或已说明无需测试的原因。
- [ ] User-facing documentation and English/Chinese text are synchronized when applicable. / 适用时已同步用户文档与中英文文案。
- [ ] No token, private path, real IDE config, `docs/`, `logs/`, generated `dist/`, or release artifact is committed. / 未提交敏感信息、本地资料或生成产物。
- [ ] Configuration writes preserve preview, backup, verify, and rollback boundaries. / 配置写入保持预览、备份、验证和回退边界。
- [ ] I accept that this contribution is provided under the repository's MIT License. / 我同意本贡献按仓库 MIT License 提供。
